findings.issue: H5560 is a common noun (fine flour); sólet leaves it as an untranslated Hebrew form.
Qal passive participles of H1101 license mixed/mingled; amasadas narrows that to kneading.
Hophal passive participle of H7246 stays open between mixed/stirred and soaked; remojada resolves it to soaking.
Hiphil imperfect 3ms is put in the future subjunctive; that mood is not in the yiqtol, and acercare is also the 1st-person form.

notes: Other tokens keep number, participants, article, construct, and the three בשמן phrases.
